anomalies.description: A person in a black helmet and leather jacket is seen holding a handgun and firing it toward the green car; muzzle flash and recoil are visible in frame f10 (13.0s).
A green car is struck (likely by gunfire or impact), producing a sudden plume of smoke/vapor from its roof and windshield area, indicating damage consistent with a high-impact event.
The green car's windshield is struck by projectiles, causing visible shattering and spray of glass/water; steam or smoke erupts from the hood immediately after impact in frame f12 (14.0s).

A second round of gunfire occurs: two helmeted individuals are seen in frame f14 (15.0s) with one holding a firearm, and frame f15 (15.5s) shows a figure on the roof of the green car reacting amid smoke and debris, consistent with ongoing shooting.

The green car sustains further damage: a large object (possibly a person or debris) impacts the roof, causing visible deformation and spray, followed by bullet holes appearing on the side window in subsequent frames.
A bright muzzle flash is visible from a firearm held by the front rider in the two-person motorcycle, indicating active gunfire.
Multiple armed individuals on motorcycles discharge firearms; bright muzzle flashes are visible, confirming active shooting.
Another muzzle flash occurs from a firearm, consistent with ongoing gunfire; the flash is large and bright, suggesting close-range discharge.
A sudden, violent explosion erupts from the rear of the green car, producing a large fireball and dense smoke, consistent with a fuel tank or pyrotechnic detonation.

The green car is violently thrown into the air and flips over, landing on its roof/side amid intense fire and debris, indicating a high-energy impact or blast-induced launch followed by catastrophic vehicle destruction.

The green sports car (Mitsubishi Eclipse) comes to rest on its wheels, heavily damaged and fully engulfed in flames; this phase represents the aftermath of the crash, with sustained fire but no further impact motion.
A green sports car is shown mid-impact, flipping or rolling violently with intense fire and smoke erupting around it; the vehicle is airborne or heavily distorted, indicating a high-energy crash.

A sudden, massive fireball erupts from the vehicle at the start of the sequence, with rapid expansion and bright white-orange core, consistent with a fuel or pyrotechnic explosion rather than sustained burning.
